quotes.summary_phrase: AJ Dybantsa on the difficulty of moving between schools
quotes.excerpt: If I see you getting eight minutes somewhere else, that next move you can't get 16.
quotes.quote: If I see you getting eight minutes somewhere else, that next move you can't get 16. It's hard now. I'm staying. AJ stamped it. Stamped the hood woes. I'm not messing with hood woes. It's just some bad takes.

quotes.speaker: AJ Dybantsa

quotes.summary_phrase: AJ Dybantsa on the challenges of being in the spotlight

quotes.quote: It's been hard being in the limelight, but for the rest of my life I'm going to be in it, so it's good that I got it early, to be honest. I didn't like it, but it's good that I got it early.

quotes.speaker: AJ Dybantsa
quotes.summary_phrase: AJ Dybantsa on his academic experience at BYU
quotes.excerpt: A lot of people thought I would just cruise through it. I was in class.
quotes.quote: It was solid. A lot of people thought I would just cruise through it. I was in class, like, four in-person classes. I would sit like front row, everything, Book of Mormon class, all that. I had like two classes online, but it was like because there was literally TAs, there was no teacher, but I was in class, I was scootering around campus, golf cart, right to class, front row.

quotes.speaker: AJ Dybantsa

quotes.excerpt: We all knew who Dillon Brooks was, but the fact that he was playing with a lot of people.

quotes.speaker: AJ Dybantsa
quotes.summary_phrase: AJ Dybantsa on his approach to handling double teams
quotes.excerpt: I have one thing I'm going to do and if you end up beating me, I have one counter.
quotes.quote: I have one thing I'm going to do and if you end up beating me, I have one counter and one of the two is going to work. A lot of people are shorter than me, so I'll just get to the spot. If they beat me, I'll still shoot it because you're going to have to foul me. But if they're bigger and they're fast, I have a couple counters that should work.
